### O9 — Extended ingest call exceeded 30 second client timeout for agentic-kit uncommitted catalog uplift

- **Symptom:** Extended ingest call exceeded 30 second client timeout for agentic-kit uncommitted catalog uplift
- **Evidence:**
  - **Tool:** ingest
  - **Expected:** Refresh receipt or queued run ID within client timeout
  - **Actual:** POST /rpc/extended tools/call ingest did not return in 30 seconds
  - **Repro:** tools/call ingest service agentic-kit at HEAD 5d4c989 with catalog-kit uncommitted files
- **Root cause:** The synchronous refresh outlasted this client deadline; a later find_symbol returned the new ResolveProfile. Engine-side latency/root cause is still uninvestigated.
- **Fix:** No engine change here. Retained resource diagnostics, gracefully stopped the unresponsive managed service and restarted it through launchd. Health and strict verification recovered.
- **Status:** open
- **Impact:** Refresh did complete, but a later strict verifier timed out probing GET /indexed and exited 2. CK-5 was held unchecked until recovery; a fresh successful verifier now proves its actual CLI path. No proof claim relies on timed-out responses.
